caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical jar or vessel positioned upright at the center of the composition. The jar is mostly beige or tan in color, with several decorative horizontal blue bands around its body. There are two straight blue bands near the top rim, one band encircling the base, and two wavy blue lines running laterally around the middle portion of the jar. The jar's top opening is round and appears dark inside, suggesting depth. The surface of the jar is smooth, and the background is plain and unadorned, consisting of an off-white or light cream color. There are no additional objects or details in the background.
